entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I hope you can help me. I ordered a jersey a while back, and it's just not right. I need to return it.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your order number?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I was so excited for it, but when I finally tried it on... it's the wrong size. It's just so much smaller than I expected.
I see the order. Just to be clear, is the issue a sizing preference, or do you believe there's a manufacturing defect with the item?

Oh, no defect. It's just... really too tight. I was going to do an exchange, but honestly, things are a bit tight financially right now and I really need the money back. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I was just really hoping you could help me out.
I understand completely. Let me just pull up our policy for you. One moment.

Okay, I've got it. I see the jersey was delivered 39 days ago. You're well within our 90-day return window for standard items, so that's no problem at all. I can process this return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful! Thank you so much, Alex. That's a huge weight off my shoulders.

You're very welcome. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Just package the jersey, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
